hero.title: Egyptian furniture, produced and exported for wholesale buyers.
hero.body: AL NASR FURNITURE supplies Egyptian furniture to importers, wholesalers, distributors and retail showrooms — coordinating design, production, quality checks, packaging and export through the manufacturing network we work with in Egypt.
hero.note: B2B supply only, with an initial focus on GCC markets. Every order is quoted individually.

about.title: About AL NASR FURNITURE
about.lead: Egyptian furniture manufacturing & export solutions for importers, furniture traders and project buyers.
whoBody: AL NASR FURNITURE is the commercial brand of Al Nasr for Import & Export (مؤسسة النصر للاستيراد والتصدير), an Egyptian business focused on supplying and exporting Egyptian furniture to international markets. We combine coordinated manufacturing, a variety of designs and attention to detail to meet the needs of importers, furniture traders and buyers in different markets.

Through the manufacturing and showroom network we work with in Egypt, we offer a complete range of home furniture — bedroom sets, kids' bedrooms, corner sofas, living room sets, china cabinets and dining rooms — in modern and classic designs, with designs, sizes and finishes that can be produced to customer requirements.

We follow each order from design and specifications, through production, finishing and quality review, to packaging and export preparation — so every stage is coordinated to the requirements of the order and the target market.

mq.title: Manufacturing & quality
mq.body: We pay attention to every stage of furniture production — from selecting materials and defining specifications, through manufacturing and finishing, to reviewing products and preparing them for packing and shipment.

mq.title: Made-to-order
mq.body: Made-to-order production can be coordinated, covering designs, sizes, finishes and quantities, according to available capabilities and agreement with the customer.

mq.title: Export services
mq.body: Export of Egyptian furniture for importers, wholesalers, retailers and project furnishing companies — with packaging, export documents and international shipping coordinated according to destination and contract terms.

about.visionBody: To become a trusted partner in manufacturing and exporting Egyptian furniture, and to expand the presence of our products in global markets through quality, design variety and long-term business relationships.
about.partnersBody: Production, finishing and showroom presentation are carried out through the manufacturing and showroom network we work with in Egypt, while AL NASR FURNITURE manages the commercial relationship with buyers. Partner names and facility imagery will be published only once their use is authorized.
about.ctaBody: Whether you are a furniture importer, wholesaler, retailer or project developer, we are ready to discuss your requirements and offer furniture solutions suited to your market.

sourcing.title: How export orders are handled
sourcing.lead: From the first inquiry to shipment — how a wholesale furniture order is specified, produced, checked, packed and shipped with our partners in Egypt.
coordBody: Our export service is built for importers, wholesalers, retailers and project furnishing companies who want one accountable contact in Egypt.

We coordinate packaging, export documents and international shipping arrangements with our partners according to the destination and the contract terms — so buyers do not have to manage each supplier separately.

steps.title: Inquiry
steps.body: The customer sends the required products, quantities, dimensions, designs and specifications.

steps.title: Quotation
steps.body: The request is reviewed and a quotation is prepared covering products, quantities, specifications, and delivery, payment and shipping terms.

steps.title: Specification confirmation
steps.body: Design, materials, colours, dimensions, final finishes and packaging requirements are agreed.

steps.title: Order confirmation
steps.body: Once the commercial and technical details and contract terms are agreed, the order is confirmed and execution begins.

steps.title: Production
steps.body: Products are manufactured and prepared to the agreed specifications, in coordination with the manufacturer.

steps.title: Quality control (QC)
steps.body: Products are reviewed against the agreed specifications, including dimensions, materials, finishes and condition before packing.

steps.title: Export packaging
steps.body: Packing materials and methods suited to the furniture and the transport mode are selected, to reduce the risk of scratches, impact and damage.

steps.title: Container loading
steps.body: Products are arranged in the container to suit the shipment, make use of the available space and protect the goods.

steps.title: Shipping documents
steps.body: Required documents are prepared according to the shipment, the importing country and the agreed payment and delivery terms.

steps.title: Shipment
steps.body: Goods are shipped to the agreed port of arrival or place of delivery, under the delivery term specified in the contract.

faq.a: Customization requests can be included in your inquiry. Whether a change is possible depends on the collection and manufacturing capabilities, and is confirmed during the quotation discussion.

faq.q: Which delivery and payment terms are available?
faq.a: We work with EXW, FOB, CFR and CIF delivery terms and three payment options. The applicable terms are agreed for each order before confirmation; not every option is available for every order.

faq.q: What details help us prepare a quotation?
faq.a: Collection references, quantities per collection, destination country and port, any specification or finish changes, your preferred delivery term and your preferred contact method.

faq.q: Are prices, lead times or transit times published?
faq.a: No. They depend on volume, specifications, destination and sailing schedules, and are given as estimates in each quotation.

ship.title: Shipping & payment guide
ship.lead: How payment, delivery terms, ports, containers and shipment volume are handled for furniture export orders from Egypt. All terms are agreed per order before confirmation.
ship.payIntro: We offer three payment options. The appropriate method is chosen according to the nature of the transaction and the contract terms.

payments.title: 30% advance payment + 70% against shipping documents
payments.body: 30% of the order value is paid in advance on order confirmation. The remaining 70% is paid against the shipping documents, according to the document-release terms agreed in the contract.

payments.title: Irrevocable letter of credit at sight
payments.body: Transactions can be made through an irrevocable documentary credit, with payment on presentation of shipping documents that comply with the credit terms, under the banking procedures agreed between both parties.

payments.title: Direct bank transfer
payments.body: The order value can be paid by direct bank transfer according to the payment terms agreed between both parties and set out in the quotation and commercial contract.

ship.payNote: The payment method, its conditions and the required documents are agreed before the order is confirmed and execution begins. Not every option is automatically available for every order.
ship.incoIntro: We offer different delivery terms depending on the shipment destination, the nature of the order and the buyer's requirements. Terms are interpreted under Incoterms® 2020 and apply to the named place or port stated in the contract.

incoterms.name: Ex Works
incoterms.seller: Prepares the goods and makes them available for collection at the agreed named place. Not required to load or export-clear the goods.
incoterms.buyer: Loading, export clearance, all transport, import clearance and subsequent procedures, as per the contract.
incoterms.risk: When the goods are placed at the buyer's disposal at the named place.
incoterms.insurance: No obligation on either party; the buyer insures if desired.

incoterms.name: Free On Board
incoterms.seller: Prepares the goods, handles export clearance and delivers them on board the vessel at the named port of shipment.
incoterms.buyer: Nominates the vessel, arranges and pays sea freight, and handles import clearance and duties.
incoterms.cost: Buyer pays the main sea freight.
incoterms.risk: When the goods are on board the vessel at the port of shipment.
incoterms.insurance: No obligation on either party; the buyer arranges cover if desired.

incoterms.name: Cost and Freight
incoterms.seller: Handles export clearance; arranges and pays sea freight to the agreed port of destination.
incoterms.buyer: Import clearance and duties, and destination charges not included in the freight contract.
incoterms.cost: Seller pays sea freight to the destination port.
incoterms.risk: When the goods are on board the vessel at the port of shipment — before the main voyage.
incoterms.insurance: Not included; the seller has no obligation to insure. Buyer cover is recommended.

incoterms.name: Cost, Insurance and Freight
incoterms.seller: As CFR, plus obtaining cargo insurance for the voyage to the destination port.
incoterms.buyer: Import clearance and duties, and destination charges not included in the freight contract.
incoterms.cost: Seller pays sea freight and insurance.
incoterms.risk: When the goods are on board the vessel at the port of shipment.
incoterms.insurance: Seller provides minimum cover (Institute Cargo Clauses C) unless broader cover is agreed separately.

incoNotes: FOB, CFR and CIF are rules for sea and inland waterway transport.
For containerised cargo handed over at a terminal before loading on board, FCA or another rule may be more appropriate depending on the actual delivery arrangements; this is discussed case by case.
Under CFR and CIF the seller pays freight to destination, but risk passes to the buyer at the port of shipment.
ship.portsIntro: Shipments can be arranged from suitable Egyptian ports, depending on the destination, shipping line availability and cost.
ship.portsNote: The final port of shipment depends on the nature of the order, where the goods are prepared, the available shipping line and the transport cost. These are possible departure ports — not a guarantee that every route is available at all times.
ship.contIntro: The container type is chosen according to shipment volume, furniture dimensions, packaging and how products are arranged inside, to make the best use of loading space.

containers.name: 20 FT Standard
containers.body: Suited to small and medium shipments, depending on furniture volume and packing method.

containers.name: 40 FT Standard
containers.body: Suited to larger shipments, taking product dimensions and loading requirements into account.

containers.name: 40 FT High Cube
containers.body: Greater internal height than the standard 40 FT, giving extra flexibility when loading furniture and packing materials.

contNote: These figures are indicative planning estimates, not guaranteed capacity. Usable furniture volume is lower than a container's geometric internal volume, and varies with item dimensions, packaging, knock-down (KD) versus assembled products, weight limits, and the loading and stowage method.
The most suitable container for each shipment is determined from the order details, product dimensions and packing method.
ship.cbmIntro: Total shipment volume in cubic metres is used to determine the number of containers needed and to estimate shipping costs.
ship.cbmExample: One carton of 2.00 × 0.60 × 0.50 m = 0.60 CBM. 20 such cartons = 12.0 CBM.
cbmFactors: Dimensions of each piece after packing
Whether the furniture can be knocked down and reassembled
How products are arranged in the container
Space needed to protect products in transit
ship.cbmNote: Total CBM must use actual packed dimensions multiplied by quantities. A total below a container's rated range does not by itself guarantee that the goods will physically fit.
ship.transitBody: Sea transit time varies with the destination country and port, the shipping line, the number of transshipment stops, sailing schedules and port operating conditions.
ship.transitNote: An estimated transit time is provided for each order with the quotation. Actual times may vary with sailing schedules and transport conditions. We do not publish fixed transit times.
ship.ctaBody: Share products, quantities, destination and your preferred terms — we will prepare a quotation covering volume, packaging and shipping.

custom.title: Custom furniture & project supply
custom.lead: Alongside our wholesale collections, we review made-to-order designs and furnishing requests for qualified projects — subject to production feasibility.
custom.customBody: We can review designs supplied by the customer and produce furniture to the required dimensions and specifications, depending on production feasibility. Not every design can be manufactured; feasibility is confirmed after review.
custom.sendNote: After reviewing the details, we prepare a suitable quotation. Our sales team will advise how to share drawings and image files after your first inquiry.
custom.projBody: We can review furniture requests for residential, commercial and hotel projects according to the required specifications and quantities.
custom.assessBody: Quantities, production duration, customization, contract and shipping terms are determined separately for every project.
custom.focusNote: Our core business remains wholesale supply to furniture importers, wholesalers, distributors and showrooms; project requests are evaluated individually.
custom.ctaTitle: Have a project or custom design in mind?
custom.ctaBody: Tell us about the project, quantities and specifications. We will review feasibility and come back to you with next steps.
